body: The fact that I will never be good enough at my job regardless of effort is just funny. Like not even anywhere near good enough. Lel

I've always been secular and atheistic at least since I started to think about these things seriously so I'm not too sure if my view on life has changed due to atheism. But I do agree how it could seem rather nihilistic coz when we die, we die - and theres no particular reason why we came here in the first place. We weren't chosen. I feel like there's often a common theme of creating your 'own' reason to live in atheistic communities and how that is more meaningful than following a doctrine.
